function: function (p. 7): learned diffusion models augment acceleration-jerk spectra computed from Wi-Fi CSI and a ResNet-18 counts dynamic targets; this is wireless sensing, outside the seven areas.
notes: Reason function. p. 7: "we train a ResNet based classifier using the augmented AJ spectra to detect the number of targets"; p. 6: "Based on the collected AJ spectra, we first train the conditional diffusion model to expand the data quantity". The learned models generate and denoise sensing spectra and classify the number of targets; they design no beam, waveform or resource, detect no symbols and estimate no channel, and the only metrics are FID and detection accuracy (p. 9). The AJ spectra are sensing features computed from CSI by FFTs and a keystone transform (pp. 4-5), not channel samples, so channel synthesis of area 2 does not apply. Learned components exist, so not no_learning. The PDF is arXiv:2502.12622v1 (p. 1), titled 'Generative AI Enabled Robust Data Augmentation for Wireless Sensing in ISAC Networks'; it prints no DOI, so its match with the DOI could not be checked in the file.
